title: Blood center return bundle omits the period donation directory
actual: The bundle describes opening a donation, but only lists return totals, a PDF and donation detail. The computed totals contain no donation reference. The existing period donation list answers an authorised Quality user.
expected: Name GET /blood-center/donations with the period filters as the source for the donation number, or document an authorised handoff. Keep the donor presentation limited to number, age and sex.
steps: Read current get_screen_bundle('blood_center_registers') including endpoints and handoffs, then read get_endpoint for GET /blood-center/donations. Call the directory using the documented filter as demo.quality. Compare the resulting available source with the operations named in the bundle.
evidence: DEV build 2026-11-07T10:03:18.175586+00:00. Actual source GET 200, request_id 1cee8ec009e143dfb24bf31d64f91fa6. The selected filter had zero demo records. This report is about the missing source in the bundle. The existing call is available and permission checked.
